#!/bin/bash
set -e
W=/tmp/bench77579349
N="sudo $W/bin/nerdctl"
cd $W/compose
# Docker provider again, its endpoint the containerd socket (a gRPC socket, not a Docker API): Traefik runs, discovers nothing
cat > docker-compose.yaml <<'YEOF'
version: "3"

services:
  traefik:
    image: traefik:v3.0
    container_name: traefik
    volumes:
      - /run/bench77579349/containerd.sock:/var/run/containerd/containerd.sock
    command:
      - "--api.insecure=true"
      - "--log.level=DEBUG"
      - "--entrypoints.web.address=:80"
      - "--entrypoints.web-secure.address=:443"
      - "--providers.docker=true"
      - "--providers.docker.endpoint=unix:///var/run/containerd/containerd.sock"
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"

  apache:
    image: httpd:latest
    container_name: apache
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.apache.rule=Host(`example.com`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.apache.entrypoints=web"
      - "traefik.http.services.apache.loadbalancer.server.port=80"
YEOF
$N compose up -d
sleep 3

#!/bin/bash
set -e
W=/tmp/bench77579349
N="sudo $W/bin/nerdctl"
cd $W/compose
# the compose project as it is (Traefik exits), and a small proxy process on the HOST in front of the Apache container
$N compose up -d
sleep 2
APACHE_IP=$($N inspect --format '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' apache)
cat > $W/proxy.py <<'PYEOF'
import http.client, http.server, sys
BACKEND = sys.argv[1]
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if (self.headers.get("Host") or "").split(":")[0] != "example.com":
            self.send_response(404); self.send_header("Content-Length", "0"); self.end_headers(); return
        c = http.client.HTTPConnection(BACKEND, 80, timeout=5); c.request("GET", "/", headers={"Host": "example.com"}); r = c.getresponse(); b = r.read()
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(self, *a): pass
http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 80), H).serve_forever()
PYEOF
sudo setsid nohup python3 $W/proxy.py $APACHE_IP >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null &
sleep 2
